units.source_text: 夫人站在石桥上的时候，飘起了毛毛细雨。

en.t: When the lady was standing on the stone bridge, a fine drizzle began to fall.

units.source_text: 不久大颗的雨点下个不停。

en.t: Before long, large raindrops were falling without stopping.

units.source_text: 大竹七段不知道下雨，别人告诉他时，他说了声“大概老天爷也患肾脏病啦”，然后望了望庭院。

en.t: Ot竹 7-dan did not know it was raining, and when someone told him, he said, “I suppose heaven must have kidney disease too,” then looked out at the garden.
